links.outcome: Rate of medically incorrect chatbot answers (accuracy ≤3) to PRRT patient questions
links.effect: Medically incorrect information (accuracy ≤3) appeared in 7-8% of responses, with no significant difference between ChatGPT 4o and DeepSeek V3 (P = 0.8005). Mean accuracy was 4.43 vs 4.56.
links.quote: However, the presence of medical inaccuracies highlights the need for physician oversight when using AI chatbots for patient education.

screen.reason: The study evaluates the accuracy, readability, and conciseness of two LLMs (ChatGPT 4o and DeepSeek V3) answering patient inquiries about PRRT, evaluated retrospectively by expert clinicians without testing a specific deployment safeguard.
